NOTICE OF A PUBLIC HEARING
PLANNING COMMISSION
What?
Notice is hereby given that the Cottonwood Heights Planning Commission will hold a public
hearing and make possible recommendations to the City Council on city-initiated requests for three
Zoning Text Amendments. These amendments will modify:
• CHMC Chapter 19.89 regarding Short Term Rentals (File: ZTA-26-006),
• CHMC Chapter 19.75 regarding Accessory Dwelling Units (File: ZTA-26-007), and
• CHMC Chapter 19.76 regarding Fencing (File: ZTA-26-008).

When and Where?
The meeting will be held on Wednesday, December 2, 2026, at Cottonwood Heights City Hall
(2277 E. Bengal Blvd.). The meeting will be split into two sessions:
1. Work Session – 5:00 p.m. – City Council Work Room
2. Business Session – 6:00 p.m. – City Council Chambers
Both sessions will also be broadcast electronically on the city’s YouTube channel at
https://www.youtube.com/@CottonwoodHeights/streams.

How Can I Learn More about these Projects?
The meeting agenda and staff report for these projects will be posted online to the city website. To
view these materials, please visit www.ch.utah.gov/planningcommission, and click on “Agendas,
Packets, & Minutes.” These materials will be posted by end of day on Thursday, November 26,
2026, the Thursday prior to the meeting. Questions about the projects can be directed to city staff at
planning@ch.utah.gov, or 801-944-7000.

How Can I Make a Public Comment?
Verbal public comments are accepted at the public hearing during the 6:00 p.m. Business Session
(but not during the 5:00 p.m. Work Session). Verbal comments provided during the public hearing
will be limited to three minutes per commenter except as otherwise specified on the meeting
agenda.
Alternatively, written comments can be submitted to staff via email at planning@ch.utah.gov. For
written comments to be entered into the record and distributed to the Planning Commission prior to
the meeting, they must be submitted to staff by 12:00 p.m. MST on Tuesday, December 1, 2026, the
day prior to the meeting. Comments received after this deadline will be distributed to the Planning
Commission after the meeting.
Posted: November 17, 2026, Attest: Tiffany Janzen, City Recorder
2277 E. Bengal Blvd. Cottonwood Heights, Utah 84121
City Hall: (801) 944-7000 Fax: (801) 944-7005
